status: Source discovery and bounded geographic acquisition only; not simulator integration or historical reconstruction.

downloaded_pilot.publisher: Instituto de Estadística y Cartografía de Andalucía / DERA
downloaded_pilot.collection_scope: Current geographic pilot; not a 2021 reconstruction or complete provincial inventory

records.spatial_selection: Service-returned pilot selection, not an exact clipped footprint; two returned points lie outside the requested bbox. Verify and filter locally before geographic joins.
Features intersecting requested bbox; full geometries are not clipped

limitations: Current service snapshots; acquisition time is not feature observation or publication time.
Bboxes are pilot areas, not verified EGIF incident locations or a complete provincial inventory.
Emergency coordination facilities include maritime coordination and 112; not identified as CEDEFO or available fire crews.
Road geometries are not a validated routable graph and do not supply fire closures, speeds or travel time.
No terrain, weather, fuel, historical incident join or simulator input was added.
Source-level attribution and redistribution terms must be checked before publication.

sources.access: API key required; obtain via official portal.
limits: The documented historical climatology endpoint is daily, not minute-level wind or humidity.
Check historical hourly station coverage separately; recent observation endpoints are not an archive guarantee.
Retain station distance, elevation, units, timestamps, missingness and actual availability evidence.

sources.access: CDS account, accepted dataset terms and configured access for API downloads.
sources.purpose: Hourly historical weather context; 0.1 degree grid, native resolution about 9 km.
limits: Reanalysis estimates, not incident-scene measurements or historically available forecasts.
Derived humidity must be labelled derived and its inputs/formula retained.
Never assign availability_at equal to the historical weather valid time without evidence.
Interpolation cannot create observed minute-resolution gusts; engine wind-index conversion requires a separate validated adapter.

sources.access: Official downloads and geographic coverage services; acquire one local tile/subset first.
sources.purpose: Elevation and slope from MDT products, initially MDT25.
limits: Record acquisition/survey and product edition, CRS, horizontal/vertical units and nodata.
Modern elevation is context, not proof of historical road access or fire behavior.

sources.access: Official WFS services; national transport capabilities request timed out in this pilot.
sources.purpose: Transport, geographic names and administrative units.
limits: Availability listed in documentation is not a successful download.
Road geometry does not establish speed, crew transit time, closures or a valid routing graph.

sources.publisher: Instituto de Estadística y Cartografía de Andalucía
sources.access: Public WFS; three bounded GeoJSON extracts successfully acquired without credentials.
sources.purpose: Regional roads, public fire-station locations and emergency coordination facilities.
limits: Current snapshots are not verified 2021 records.
Fire stations and coordination sites must not be relabelled CEDEFO or initial unit readiness.
The broad facility bbox includes neighboring provinces; 11 of 20 returned fire stations have Huelva province labels.
One road request returned a truncated 1001 of 1058 matches; the accepted request retrieved all 1058 and checked unique feature IDs.
Property selection requested only IDs, names, categories, municipality/province and geometry; no phone, email, postal address or contact URLs were retained.

sources.access: Download by area / download API; authentication and exact selected distribution not yet tested.
sources.purpose: Historical land-cover classes; 100 m raster or vector, 2018 reference year.
limits: 44 land-cover classes and a 25 ha minimum mapping unit; not measured fuel moisture or a calibrated fuel model.
Pin the product edition as well as the reference year; later revisions may incorporate retrospective knowledge.
Land-cover-to-combustibility mapping remains an explicitly synthetic model assumption until validated.

sources.access: Annual INE downloads and geographic nomenclator; no population file downloaded in this pilot.
sources.purpose: Settlement names, codes, locations and resident counts.
limits: Use a compatible reference year and join verified codes, not ambiguous names alone.
Registered population is not the number present during the incident, evacuation demand or compliance.

sources.access: Public mapping products; vector download not tested in this pilot.
sources.purpose: Incident-specific fire extents, mapped affected areas and product delivery timestamps.
limits: EMSR545 is a separate Malaga September 2021 incident, not a verified match to the existing four anchors.
Observation, production and delivery dates differ; final perimeters stay evaluator-only unless the simulated decision clock permits a genuinely received product.
Mapped perimeter is not ignition, continuous spread history, suppression attribution or evidence of optimal actions.

sources.purpose: Named Huelva CEDEFO sites and published provincial response capacities.
limits: Province totals and facility names do not identify initial unit inventories, rosters, readiness or per-incident allocations.
No public minute-level dispatch, call transcripts, delivery/readback logs or population compliance records acquired.

next_gates: Verify an incident location, coordinate reference system, date/timezone and spatial uncertainty; do not use a province centroid as ignition.
Choose a single pilot incident with defensible geography and obtain same-area terrain, historical land cover and compatible settlement population.
Acquire a short hourly weather window, record observation versus reanalysis provenance and do not claim historical availability without evidence.
Verify exact-byte hashes, source licenses, CRS transformations, nodata, spatial bounds, temporal joins and source-to-derived lineage.
Build clipped offline context packs and versioned engine adapters separately; preserve frozen benchmarks and keep unverified data out of actor inputs.
Review routing, unit readiness, shelter, smoke, communication and suppression assumptions with domain evidence before expanding cases.
rights: Raw extracts remain in ignored local evaluator storage. No dataset publication or redistribution clearance is claimed.
